name: dense-feature-matrix-development-gates-v1
claim_ceiling: representation and selector development on three licensed families only; not public-validation, private-holdout, independent, category-best, market-leading, or state-of-the-art evidence

contamination_boundary.production_inputs: bounded bytes from the current input and complete framed candidate sizes only
contamination_boundary.consumed_tbl1_families: no bytes, statistics, codec deltas, header spelling, feature counts, or fitted thresholds from MetroPT, electricity load, OULAD, or OCRB may contribute

hypotheses.name: separator-aware token alphabets
hypotheses.representation: losslessly split alternating field lexemes and exact separator runs, dictionary-code each alphabet, bit-pack indices, and entropy-code the complete representation

hypotheses.name: typed integer and binary planes
hypotheses.representation: when bounded parsing proves a rectangular integer or binary matrix, retain exact lexeme and separator reconstruction metadata while coding column-major values, deltas, or bit planes

hypotheses.name: fixed-row byte planes
hypotheses.representation: when bounded bytes prove stable row widths, transpose byte positions or small byte groups without semantic parsing and preserve row terminators exactly

selector_gates.training: leave one development family out; no row may use evaluation-only metadata

decision_rule: A representation may advance to the successor candidate only if every ratio, operational, selector, integrity, and record-table-preservation gate passes on fresh development data. Public validation remains sealed until candidate code, selector, format, gates, runner, evaluator, and lock receipt are merged.
